cases.prompt: Add a way to mark a todo as done by id.
expectations: Reads todos.js and the existing test before writing code
Adds a function that follows the existing style and validation approach
Handles an unknown id explicitly, consistent with existing error handling
Adds tests for success and the unknown-id case and runs them
States or asks about decisions that change the design, such as date format, time zones, and whether due dates are optional
Keeps existing behavior working when no due date is given
